item: Field data: instance tag in every file; qualification export and proposed new sources
summary: Every Field data file is named oo-field-<press>-<instance>-... with a random tag kept in the data folder (instance_id, never a path hash). The button also saves the source-qualification export and a candidate-sources zip: sources this install qualified by its own measurement that no shipped catalogue has, with tags and evidence, feed addresses without user/query, newsletters left out. scripts/propose_source_additions.py groups them across instances into a review table; every row stays proposed and nothing reaches a catalogue without a reviewed PR.
